subject.title: fix(devices): recover unknown requestId approvals in password mode

question: Should OpenClaw accept a loopback-only local file approval fallback for method-level password-mode `unknown requestId` errors once real behavior proof is added?
rationale: The patch fixes a real recovery deadlock, but it expands an admin-equivalent local approval path that can approve a refreshed request ID the operator did not type.

options.title: Accept after proof
options.body: Require redacted terminal/log proof for the password-mode loopback scenario, then accept the bounded fallback contract.

options.title: Require stricter design
options.body: Ask for a narrower owner-approved recovery path, such as doctor-mediated repair, before expanding CLI fallback approval.

options.title: Pause in favor of broader recovery
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers want one design covering approval, reject, downgrade, and bootstrap recovery together.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted terminal/log proof for the password-mode loopback scenario, then accept the bounded fallback contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged replacement-request compatibility gate that this PR builds on.
